description: Stacklok ToolHive MCP servers and Virtual MCP (enablePrometheusMetricsPath, diagnostics port 9464): MCP requests, errors and latency per server, tool calls, active connections, vMCP backends and workflows, Redis rate limits and the embedded auth server.

panels.title: MCP requests/s
panels.description: MCP requests proxied to the selected servers.

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: Requests answered with HTTP status >= 400.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(toolhive_mcp_requests_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", server=~"$server", status="error"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(toolhive_mcp_requests_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", server=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Request p95
panels.description: 95th percentile MCP request duration.

panels.title: Tool calls/s
panels.description: tools/call requests per second.

panels.title: Active connections
panels.description: Open MCP connections (SSE streams).

panels.title: Rate-limited/s
panels.description: Requests rejected by the Redis rate limiter.

panels.title: Requests by MCP method
panels.description: initialize, tools/list, tools/call, resources/read... sse_connection counts new SSE streams.

panels.title: Requests by server and status
panels.description: HTTP status returned per MCP server.

panels.title: Request latency
panels.description: MCP request duration measured by the ToolHive proxy.

panels.title: Latency p95 by method
panels.description: Slow methods usually are tools/call on a slow backend.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, mcp_method) (rate(toolhive_mcp_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", server=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Tool calls by tool
panels.description: tools/call per server and tool.

panels.title: Tool errors
panels.description: Tool calls that failed at the HTTP level.

targets.expr: sum by (server, tool) (rate(toolhive_mcp_tool_calls_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", server=~"$server", status="error"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Top tools (range)
panels.description: Most called tools over the selected range.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (server, tool) (increase(toolhive_mcp_tool_calls_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", server=~"$server"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Tool duration p95 (MCP semconv)
panels.description: p95 of mcp.server.operation.duration for tools/call, by tool.

panels.title: Active connections by server
panels.description: Open connections per server and transport.

panels.title: Operations by method (MCP semconv)
panels.description: Same traffic seen through the OpenTelemetry MCP semantic conventions metric.

panels.title: Backends discovered
panels.description: Backends aggregated by the Virtual MCP server.

panels.title: Backend requests
panels.description: Requests vMCP sends to each backend MCP server.

panels.title: Backend errors
panels.description: Failed backend calls by action (call_tool, list_capabilities...).

panels.title: Backend latency p95
panels.description: Duration of calls from vMCP to each backend.

panels.title: Workflows
panels.description: Composite tool workflows executed by vMCP and their errors.

panels.title: Rate limit decisions
panels.description: Allowed and rejected bucket decisions, shared or per user.

panels.title: Redis errors and fail-open
panels.description: Redis failures during rate limit checks and requests let through because of them.

panels.title: Rate limit check latency p95
panels.description: Duration of the atomic Redis check.

panels.title: DCR clients and rejections
panels.description: Dynamic client registrations counted against the cap, and /oauth/register calls rejected with 503 because it was reached.

title: ToolHive
